name: Castle Pantry
description: Familiar ingredients and universal reactions bridge every deck.

residues.name: Hearth Coating
residues.text: Browning and Extraction bonus points ×1.5 / ×2. No extra heat condition.

residues.name: Cool Coating
residues.text: Infusion and Preservation bonus points ×1.5 / ×2. No extra heat condition.

residues.name: Tasting Spoon
residues.text: Small servings score ×0.80 / ×0.95 instead of ×0.65. Their slow depletion is unchanged.

residues.name: Grand Table
residues.text: Large servings with at least 3 non-system ingredient types score ×1.70 / ×1.90 instead of ×1.50.

objective.text: Serve 4 large bowls that each score at least 2 common reactions.

cards.name: Beef
cards.text: Protein pairs with Sugar for Browning at 70–110°C. At 90°C+, a Hearth furnace can spend Beef’s presence to make 1 Char, normally costing 0.20 before scoring; Banked Embers can lower that cost.

cards.name: Moon Onion
cards.text: Sugar pairs with Protein for Browning at 70–110°C or Acid for Preservation at 0–60°C. Aromatic 2 pairs with Fat for Infusion at 40–100°C.

cards.name: Butter
cards.text: Fat 2 pairs with Aromatic for Infusion at 40–100°C. An Aromatic partner such as Moon Onion lets both ingredients gain reaction points.

cards.name: Sun Lemon
cards.text: Acid 2 pairs with Mineral for Extraction at 50–120°C; its own Sugar enables Preservation at 0–60°C. At 90°C+, Acid can harvest stored Culture even though Lemon’s hot base score is weak.

cards.name: Silver Oyster
cards.text: Mineral 2 pairs with Acid for Extraction at 50–120°C. Protein also pairs with Sugar for Browning at 70–110°C, or fuels a Hearth furnace at 90°C+, normally costing 0.20 presence.

cards.name: Catalyst Salt
cards.text: Only 10 base power, but Mineral 1 with React ×3 contributes 3 effective Mineral while fully present. Pair it with Acid for Extraction at 50–120°C; its contribution fades with presence.
